tools_listed.name: check_order
tools_listed.description: Check a customer order ticket against stock and price. Looks up the ticket's sku, size and quantity, then reports units on hand, whether the order can be filled, the list price, the order total and any shortfall. Read only.

tools_listed.name: suggest_restock
tools_listed.description: Suggest what to reorder: every sold-out or low-stock item with a vendor. An item is low when its quantity is `low_stock` or fewer. The suggestion tops it up to `restock_to` units, picks the vendor whose specialty fits, and estimates cost from unit_cost and arrival from the vendor's lead time. Read only: it proposes, a person decides whether to order.

tools_listed.name: pay_invoice
tools_listed.description: Pay an open vendor invoice from the checking account. Refuses unless the invoice exists and is still open, a person is named in `approved_by`, and the checking balance covers the amount. When every check passes it records a payment, marks the invoice paid and lowers the balance. This is the only tool that changes the database.

tools_listed.name: list_tickets
tools_listed.description: List tickets in the queue, oldest first. `status` is open, in_progress, waiting_on_approval, resolved, or all. Read only.

tools_listed.name: get_ticket
tools_listed.description: Get one ticket with everything it links to: its lease, its invoice, and stock and price for its product. Read only.

tools_listed.name: update_ticket
tools_listed.description: Set a ticket's status and append a dated note saying who wrote it. status: open, in_progress, waiting_on_approval or resolved. Changes the database.

tools_listed.name: get_stock
tools_listed.description: Units on hand, location and list price for a sku, for one size or every size. Read only.

tools_listed.name: quote_price
tools_listed.description: Price a quantity at a discount: unit price, total, and margin over unit cost. Shows the biggest discount that would still not lose money. It only prices; it does not approve a discount. Read only.

tools_listed.name: list_invoices
tools_listed.description: List vendor invoices (status open, paid, or all) with the vendor name and how many days overdue each open one is. Read only.

tools_listed.name: get_cash_position
tools_listed.description: Checking balance, open bills, rent due in the next 7 days, and the cash left if all of them were paid. Read only.

tools_listed.name: get_lease
tools_listed.description: Get a lease with its rent, due date and days until it is due. Read only.

tools_listed.name: pay_rent
tools_listed.description: Pay a lease's monthly rent from checking. Refuses unless a person approves, rent is due within 7 days, and cash covers it. Records the payment and moves next_due forward one month. Changes the database.
